name: Diksha Greens Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2004, Diksha Greens Ltd is in the business of trading of timber, wooden 
logs, sawn timber, and for themanufacturing of veneer sheets.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
DGL is currently engaged in the trading and distribution of different types of commodities
 and materials. Its products are mainly supplied to retailers based in Kolkata and adjacent territories.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -28.1%
